fields.name: enable_prompt_expansion
fields.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
fields.description: If set to true, the prompt is expanded into a detailed caption (grounded in the reference images when editing) before generation.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The format of the generated image.

fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: The size of the generated image, 256 to 4096 pixels per side. If not set, a single reference image's own size (scaled to at most 4 megapixels) is used, or the first reference image's size (at most 1 megapixel) when several are given.
